Valued with a ten-year free cash flow model after stock-based pay and a forward EV/EBIT cross-check on 2028. Third quarter 2026 revenue rose 154% to $584.9 million, yet at $179.47 the price needs about 62% more revenue than the Base in every year, about $6.8 billion in 2028.
